newsitem.title: USA: Service Int'l unit to redeem convertibles.
newsitem.headline: Service Int'l unit to redeem convertibles.

text.p: Service Corp International said Friday its subsidiary, SCI Finance LLC, will redeem on June 20 all outstanding shares of its $3.125 term convertible shares, Series A, also known as TECONS.
The funeral and cemetery company said SCI will redeem the shares at $52.50 cash a share plus accrued and unpaid dividends.
It said TECONS are convertible at the option of the holder at any time before the close of business June 18 into Service Corp common at the rate of $15.05 a share of the common stock.
On that basis, it said each TECONS is convertible into about 3.32 Service Corp common shares.
As of May 15, there were 3.365 million TECONS outstanding with a face amoiunt of $168.25 million, which are convertible into 11.179 million Service Corp common shares, it said.
